text:
ash: FYI billing flagged some calls routed to org root during last night's deploy. looks like token introspect flapped and proxy collapsed origin.
mira: timeline? which deploy?
ash: normalizer v1.8 at 2025-11-05T02:00Z. spike started 02:12Z. header seen at edge: `x-origin: org/555` but original had `x-orig-origin: org/555/project/10/sa/worker`
trent: that's the collapse-on-error behavior we added. intent was safe routing, but billing got affected.
infra-bot: auth-normalizer v1.8 deployed 2025-11-05T01:58Z -> rollout 100% at 02:05Z.
billing: org/555 tokens +9% vs project/10 -9%. small $ impact but accounts noticed.
mira: quick mitigation ideas: 1) preserve original header but mark uncertified 2) add `x-origin-asserted: true|false` 3) require signature on preserved header
ash: prefer preserve+asserted flag + telemetry tag. then billing can decide.
trent: security: don't let downstream use preserved header for auth decisions unless signature present. signing plan: HMAC with proxy key, validate in downstream services.
devex: console surface: show "attribution uncertain" badge on project page and a toggle per-account "reject uncertain attribution" (returns 403).
billing: rule proposal: prefer most-specific asserted identity. if none asserted, bill to org but increment `billing.attribution_uncertain_count` and surface on the invoice review.
mira: also quota implication: if origin uncertain, do NOT apply project-level rate credits; enforce org-level caps to avoid abuse.
trent: will add header signing and a `preserve_origin_on_introspect_fail` flag gated behind a feature flag. small PR ready tonight.
infra-bot: rollout checklist created: PR -> unit tests -> staging -> canary 5% -> monitor metrics -> full rollout.
ash: telemetry: add `auth.origin_resolution=preserved_uncertain` and `billing.attribution_uncertain=true` events so dashboards can filter.
devex: I'll wire a traffic table column `uncertain_attribution_count` and add trace links. can we also tag sample traces with a friendly label?
trent: yes sample traces will have `trace.tag=auth_unresolved` and signed header snippet redacted.
ash: one more: verify we can't be spoofed. only accept signed preserved headers from internal CIDRs or with valid signature. add rotation plan for signing keys.
mira: agreed. set default behavior tolerant (preserve header) and Dedicated customers can opt-in to strict enforcement via console flag.
billing: we'll run a backfill to locate affected windows and prepare account notices; no auto adjustments without manual review.
ash: will open PR and ping infra/ops for CIDR and key rotation schedule. thanks.
